code reference as deletion candidates, and the single largest of them (nst9_, the
stage-9 bonus level) turned out to be PLANNED CONTENT, not dead weight. Mike:

so deleting one fails the suite instead of quietly shipping a broken bonus stage
six months from now when nobody remembers this conversation.
